question: Is the union of the triad of powers the true reality underlying all states?
premises: Reality is being defined in terms of a union of powers.
The triad of powers was previously identified as fundamental.
If this union is real, it grounds the states described.
inference: True reality consists in the union of the triad of powers as described.
plain_english: If this is reality, it is the union of the triad of powers in that form.
